changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwPatientEncounters AS SELECT pe.id, pe.patient_id, pe.encounter_number, pe.facility_id, pe.department_id, pe.practitioner_id, pe.appointment_id, pe.encounter_type, pe.encounter_reason, pe.follow_up_encounter_id, pe.priority, pe.origin_type, pe.origin_name, pe.notes, pe.status, pe.department_daily_sequence_number, pe.chief_complaint, pe.discharge_type, pe.discharge_at, pe.encounter_date, pe.started_by, pe.started_date, pe.created_by, pe.created_date, pe.last_modified_by, pe.last_modified_date, pe.history_of_present_illness, pe.encounter_time, pe.physical_examination_summery, pe.completed_by, pe.completed_at, pe.encounter_status, pe.billing_status, pe.financially_closed_at, pe.financially_closed_by, pe.coverage_type, pe.patient_insurance_id FROM public.patient_encounters pe;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwPatientEncounters TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwPatientEncounters FROM report_user;
